## Approach

In this assignment, I'm generating a synthetic daily price dataset for
three instruments (AAPL, MSFT, and BTC) spanning January 2022 through
December 2023, using a random walk to simulate realistic price movement.
My plan is to load this data into a SQLite table, then use real SQL
window functions not dplyr to calculate two things for each
instrument a year to date running average and a 6 day moving averge.

The main challenge is making sure the window function logic is correct
the YTD average needs to reset at the start of each calendar year and
only look backward from each row, and the 6 day moving
average needs to average the current day plus the 5 prior days, which
means the first few days of the dataset won't have a full 6 day window
to average over.
